authorization: User explicitly permitted AI relabeling or finding labels, prioritizing report completion; translated Vietnamese silver pilot disclosed before execution.
task: Presence of an explicit disaster-assistance request or unmet assistance need, including rescue/evacuation/supplies/donations; not urgency or dispatch priority
language: AI-translated Vietnamese from English CrisisMMD; not native Vietnamese reports
uncertain: preserve inventory, exclude before model fitting, report counts; no substitution
label_origin: single-pass Codex assistant/native subagents, one label per row; not human, expert, independent annotation or gold
label_view: English source text only, not image; Vietnamese translation prepared in same pass
selection: Within existing event splits, hash-sort; half broad help/need/donation/etc keyword candidates and half other text, one row per prior duplicate group; no metric-based selection. Enriched sampling, not natural prevalence.
split: retain old event split: Sri Lanka test, Maria dev, other five train; earlier English pilot/test already seen, so retrospective development evidence
source_label_use: Original informative labels not used as request labels; original agreed-label cohort selection bias retained

fusion: matched frozen DistilBERT/image blocks L2 concat /sqrt(2) with LR, plus TFIDF/image concat and arithmetic mean

bootstrap.unit: prior duplicate groups within single held-out Sri Lanka event

deployment: offline CPU only; no app/backend/model-serving changes
limits: AI labels reflect source text, not independent pair gold
